# Reusable project templates

These are blueprints for **other projects**, not current setup or migration instructions for this repository. Their version examples and provider assumptions need verification at reuse time; the Sanity v5 title does not describe the installed Sanity version here.

- [New multisite project](new-multisite-project.md) — general greenfield architecture and setup recipe.
- [New multisite project with Sanity v5](new-multisite-project-sanity-v5.md) — historical version-specific variation; not automatically the preferred or latest template.
- [Single site to multisite](single-site-to-multisite.md) — conversion blueprint with historical migration examples.

For this repository's deferred optimization work, use [the data structure recipe](../SANITY_DATA_STRUCTURE_RECIPE.md).
